status: preregistered (plan only; no build code, no data for 054)
branch_taken: plan 053 next_if_pass (Exact, GATES_053 8725569: 13/13 gated pass, certified_16n_N16 true; non-blocking GS20C_det53 pass 3/3, GS20C_sound53 pass, 0/3 decided): certify/16n is certified for declared N <= 16 under iid flips with eps <= 0.10 at per-record failure probability <= 0.001. Because GS20C_det53 passed, the conflict-only stop is kept as the fix for run-to-run variance at 20 states, and this version raises 20-state decisions with a different encoding and search, not more budget (B20 stays 2000000, C20 50000).
brand: charcoal and sage; no purple, neon, emoji or gold
question: Does a new certifier, certify/20t, that encodes rivals as colourings of the observation tree (prefix tree of the trace and experiments) with a max-clique symmetry break, decide more fresh noise-free 20-state worlds than certify/16e at the same conflict budget (B20 2000000, C20 50000), while staying sound, deterministic under a conflict-only stop, faithful, and equal to certify/16e at bound 16?

hypotheses.H1: certify/20t issues no WRONG certificate on 6 fresh 20-state worlds over two passes (12 records) or on 6 eps-0 16-state controls
hypotheses.H2: with a conflict-only stop on a 4-worker pool, the two certify/20t passes give byte-identical canonical records on 6/6 cases with 0 hard kills (053 showed this on 1 worker only)
hypotheses.H3: every certify/20t record is reproduced exactly by api_checks driving certify/20t observation by observation (run once)
hypotheses.H4: at bound 16 certify/20t gives the same label as certify/16e on 6/6 fresh clean 16-state controls, and the same canonical machine for ID (the 052 IDF-equivalence rule, unchanged)
hypotheses.H5: certify/20t decides (ID+IDF) at least 2 of 6 fresh 20-state worlds and strictly more than certify/16e (API16E20, conflict-only stop) on the same 6 seeds; the exact count is reported, not predicted

design.api: one new module brute/api/certify20t.py (certify/20t); no change to certify/16n (FREEZE_050), certify/16e (FREEZE_049), certify/16s (FREEZE_051) or any earlier module, which are imported only. certify/20t keeps certify/16e's observe / propose / result interface, labels, chunked conflict resume and the conflict-only stop (wall guards record walls and never change a result; hard job kill at 900 s). It changes the encoding and search of the stop check only: (a) states are colours of observation-tree nodes (the prefix tree of every observed word), with consistency clauses for equal outputs and determinism of transitions on colours; (b) nodes proven apart by the tree (different outputs on a common suffix) get binary inequality clauses; (c) a greedy max clique of pairwise-apart nodes is fixed to colours 0..m-1 (symmetry break), and the remaining colours are ordered by BFS over the tree; (d) the rival query is one incremental instance over sizes m..N with an at-most-N activation literal per size, instead of a fresh rival search per size. The exact clauses, the clique rule and every reading are fixed in pre-run deviation #181 before the freeze; any reading change after the freeze is a published deviation.

parts.scale20t: 6 fresh clean 20-state worlds (generator as 050/051/053 scale20), arms API20T and API20T_b (certify/20t at bound 20) and baseline API16E20 (certify/16e at bound 20, once), all at C20 50000, B20 2000000, conflict-only stop
parts.compat20t: 6 fresh clean 16-state controls (generator as 049 scale16): API20T at bound 16 vs API16E at bound 16, B 3000000, C 50000, conflict-only stop

design.caps: C 50000 per chunk everywhere; B20 2000000 for scale20t (same as 051 and 053; not raised); B 3000000 for compat20t (as 053 compat16); wall guards record only; hard job kill at 900 s for every job
design.workers: 8 in one phase: a 4-worker pool for scale20t (18 jobs) and a 4-worker pool for compat20t (12 jobs), run concurrently
design.labels: ID, IDF (identified from the current state, not the start), AMB, IDU, WRONG; scored against the clean truth

heldout_ranges.note: prefixes 1217, 1219, 1221, 1223, 1225 and 1227 had 0 word-bounded tokens prefix+00NN in tracked text files at plan time (Observed, git grep -I, 2026-10-31 EDT); compressed files were not scanned at plan time. seedcheck_054 scans every tracked file, .gz included, before any seed is used; a hit there moves the part to the next unused prefix (1223, then 1225) by a ledgered deviation before any data.

smoke_range: 12210001-12210006 (pre-freeze smoke and projection only; never gated; never used to set B, C or k)

criteria.GDET54: canon(API20T) == canon(API20T_b) byte-identical on 6/6 scale20t cases, identical conflict counts, 0 hard kills
criteria.GFID54: api_checks fidelity exact on all 12 API20T scale20t records and 6 API20T compat20t records, bound to the sealed RESULTS sha
criteria.GS20T_sound54: WRONG 0 on all 12 API20T and 6 API16E20 scale20t records and on all 12 compat20t records, against the clean truth
criteria.GS20T_gain54: API20T ID+IDF >= 2/6 on scale20t AND API20T ID+IDF > API16E20 ID+IDF on the same 6 seeds (pass 1 labels; Wilson CIs reported)
criteria.GCOMPAT20T54: 6/6 controls: API20T at bound 16 gives the same label as API16E at bound 16; for ID the same canonical machine from the start state; for IDF the same machine up to isomorphism with matching future from the current state (the 052 rule, unchanged)
criteria.GHOST54: no network; closures of certify/16n, 16e and 16s unchanged
criteria.GS_ref: CNF reference (unchanged from 053, bound set per record) audits every decided API20T record with 0 mismatches and 20/20 mutations caught; complete within 2400 s, else a published GS_ref failure
criteria.G_sound: every certified word is consistent with the truth
criteria.GTI: seedcheck PASS and no target token in prior text

certification_rule: certify/20t becomes certified for declared N <= 20 on noise-free traces iff every gated criterion passes, GS20T_gain54 included. If every gate except GS20T_gain54 passes, certify/20t is published as sound but not certified, and nothing at 20 states is certified. certify/16n, certify/16e and their certifications are not changed by this study.

secondary.GS20T_rate54: ID+IDF of 6 per arm with Wilson CIs, conflicts per decided case, conflicts/s per chunk and per case, max chunk wall (walls never used for a decision)
secondary.GS20T_paired54: per-seed paired table API20T vs API16E20: label and conflicts spent
secondary.GCOST54: conflicts, chunks, clauses and wall per part

gate_dependency_rule: each gate is scored from its own counts; label gates use recounted labels if G_recount passes, else the study labels with the failure stated; an unfinished reference is a GS_ref failure, published as-is
what_counts_as_failure: any gated criterion false; any hard kill fails GDET54; AMB and IDU are not soundness failures
freeze_rule: no file named in the source freeze is edited after the freeze; new behaviour in new files or a deviation addendum. Caps, the stop rule, the encoding readings of #181, workers and case lists are part of the freeze
runtime_estimate: worst case at 050's slowest observed rate 4503 conflicts/s: scale20t 18 x (2000000/4503 + 10) = 18 x 454 = 8172 s on 4 workers = 5 rounds x 454 = 2270 s; compat20t 12 x (3000000/4503 + 10) = 12 x 676 = 8112 s on 4 workers = 3 rounds x 676 = 2028 s; both pools run concurrently, worst case about 2270 s <= 3300 s. Cut rule: if the pre-freeze smoke projection at its slowest rate exceeds 3300 s, scale20t drops to 4 cases and then compat20t to 4, declared in #181 before the freeze.
process: LEAN, under a standing go only if one is in force and cited; a ledgered build_authorization_054 before any code and before seedcheck_054. Plan locked before data; seedcheck before seeds; no cap calibration; pre-freeze smoke with the real release verifier chain; independent recount; CNF reference audit; api_checks once after the run; main runs once with nohup and is never relaunched; failures published; one fresh-clone verify plus tests
next_if_pass: certify/20t becomes certified for declared N <= 20 on noise-free traces (Exact conditional on the declared N). Next: noise at 20 states (the certify/16n majority front end over certify/20t) and a replication of the gain on more fresh 20-state worlds.
next_if_fail: GS20T_gain54 fails with every soundness gate passing: the tree-colouring encoding alone does not raise decisions at 20 states; next try a different search at the same budget (cube-and-conquer over distinguishing-word prefixes with a deterministic cube order). GS20T_sound54, G_sound or GS_ref fails on a mismatch: certify/20t is unsound; withdraw it and find the cause before any 20-state work. GDET54 fails: the conflict-only stop is not deterministic on a shared pool; return 20-state jobs to 1 worker. GCOMPAT20T54 fails: an encoding bug at 16 states; fix it before scaling. GQB-style or G_RT failure: publish and cut cases, not budget.
limitations: 6 cases per part give wide CIs (Wilson 95% for 2/6 is [0.10, 0.70])
noise-free only at 20 states; noise at 20 states stays Open

walls depend on the host; walls never decide a result
the baseline API16E20 is run once, so its count is not double-checked for determinism in this study (053 did that on 1 worker)
open_items: IDF that fixes the start state: Open
claim_scope: conditional on the declared N: an ID or IDF means unique among machines with at most N states consistent with the trace; IDF identifies the machine from the current state, not the start. Inferred reason: a larger machine can copy the true machine on every visited state and differ only on states the trace never reached, so no finite trace rules it out.
